hardware: Intel Core i7-12700H, 16 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 3060 Laptop 6 GB (held near 250 MHz by power and thermal limits)

proposals.statement: The app must prevent missed collections to avoid re-deliveries and loss of client trust.

evidence.quote: We miss collections because messages get buried.
A re-delivery is about eighteen hundred rand, and we lose the client's trust, which is worse.

proposals.statement: The app must allow drivers to accept jobs, mark collections, take photos, and get signatures.

evidence.quote: Accept the job, mark it collected, take a photo of the waybill, and get a signature.

proposals.statement: The app must function offline and sync data when the driver returns to an area with signal.

evidence.quote: It has to work offline and send everything when they're back in range.

proposals.statement: Most drivers use Android phones, but some use basic phones, and no new phones will be purchased.

evidence.quote: Most have Android phones, their own. I think they all do, but I'd have to check.
We'd rather not buy phones for everyone if we can avoid it.

proposals.statement: The app must integrate with the existing truck tracking system and Sage invoicing software.

evidence.quote: Our trucks have a tracking system from a vendor, so we can see where they are. And invoicing runs on Sage.

proposals.statement: The budget for the project requires approval from the MD for amounts above two hundred thousand rand.

evidence.quote: Our MD signs off anything above two hundred thousand rand.

proposals.statement: The Bloemfontein depot experiences internet outages during load-shedding, preventing controller visibility.

evidence.quote: Bloemfontein goes down during load-shedding because the router isn't on the backup battery.
And when it's down, the controller can't see anything.

proposals.statement: The use of drivers' location data for the app has not been reviewed with HR and the drivers' union.

evidence.quote: Not yet. HR would have to look at that with the drivers' union.

proposals.statement: The client has not determined whether the app will include a tracking link for clients in future versions.

evidence.quote: Eventually our clients should get a tracking link, like a courier. But not now.

proposals.statement: The app should support Afrikaans to accommodate half of the drivers' language preference.

evidence.quote: And Afrikaans in the app. Half my drivers would prefer it.

proposals.statement: The project will start with a pilot at the Bloemfontein depot due to its challenging conditions.
